label: Wallbox Pulsar Plus 7.4-22 kW EV charger
description: Wallbox Pulsar Plus is a Mode 3 AC EV charger (7.4, 11 or 22 kW) with dynamic power sharing, OCPP support and control through the myWallbox app and portal. Per Wallbox's own datasheet its connectivity is Wi-Fi plus Bluetooth only - there is no Ethernet port and no PoE, and the only cabling it takes is the supply feed and the Type 2 charge cable.
